t: We've Lost Dale Earnhardt: 25 Years Later
d: In the 25 years since the death of Dale Earnhardt, much about NASCAR has changed... and much has stayed the same. Earnhardt's friends, competitors, and fans, as well as current drivers, reflect on the Intimidator's life, legacy, and lasting impact.
